item.title: Woman sentenced to life without parole for 2024 killing of 17-month-old daughter in Galveston: Docs
item.description: Channel Yonko was found guilty in the 2024 murder of her toddler and was automatically sentenced to life in prison without parole.

item.title: Secrets of the stars ahead of the Oscars: Picture perfect poses, the right dress and more
item.description: Celebrities are prepping for their moment on the red carpet -- and it turns out it takes a whole lot of effort to look effortless.

item.title: HPD relationship with ICE violates department policy, Houston Chronicle report says
item.description: New reporting from our partners at the Houston Chronicle is raising questions about how closely Houston police officers are working with ICE agents and whether HPD actions are violating its own policies.

item.title: Oscar-nominated 'The Devil Is Busy' looks at women's reproductive rights
item.description: One of this year's Oscar-nominated documentary shorts is "The Devil Is Busy," a half hour film about reproductive rights.

item.title: Minors among 17 people arrested as spring break kick-off led to Galveston Beach closures: Police
item.description: Several agencies worked together to arrest more than 15 people in a joint effort to enforce the law on "Senior Skip Day" and spring break weekend, Galveston PD said.

item.title: Casting nominee reacts to Oscars' first new category in 25 years
item.description: This new category is one that's behind-the-scenes, but without it, there could be no movie magic. Once there's a script, there needs to be actors to play the roles. That's where casting directors come in.

item.title: War with Iran's impact on oil prices could lead to higher prices on more goods in Houston area
item.description: The ongoing war in Iran is more than 7,000 miles away from the Houston metro area. Despite the distance, the war is affecting the U.S. economy.

item.title: Man admits to starting 20 to 30 fires out of boredom at various west Houston businesses
item.description: A man said he started 20 to 30 fires at various west Houston businesses because he was bored and wanted to stay warm.

item.title: Harris County juvenile judges vary widely on sending violent offenders to adult prison
item.description: When it comes to deciding whether violent juvenile offenders should finish their sentences in adult prison, Harris County judges do not always reach the same conclusions.

item.title: Plane carrying Houston passengers that crashed in Maine sat long on runway after deicing: NTSB
item.description: A preliminary NTSB report revealed the plane involved in a deadly Maine crash that carried several Houston-area passengers had spent too long on the runway after deicing.
